contract_clause: Functional Contract clauses 1, 2, 3, 4 and Acceptance Mapping rows RunId Postcard bytes, Zero value, Maximum value
domain_claim: RunId zero, representative nonzero, and u64::MAX values are legal values whose selected Postcard bytes are stable once frozen as golden fixtures and whose decoded typed value equals the original RunId.
model_boundary: vb_core::RunId value object and selected Postcard decode/encode compatibility surface; excludes arithmetic workflows because no arithmetic is required for fixture construction.
notes: Exercise at least values 0, a representative nonzero value, and u64::MAX; assert byte equality and typed decode equality. Do not assume fixed-width little-endian u64 because Postcard varint behavior must be observed and frozen.

contract_clause: Functional Contract clauses 5 and 6; Acceptance Mapping row Digest newtype compatibility
domain_claim: WorkflowDigest fixtures preserve exactly 32 bytes through construction, Postcard encode, Postcard decode, and accessor roundtrip.
model_boundary: vb_core::WorkflowDigest fixed-size byte newtype and selected Postcard encode/decode compatibility surface; excludes cryptographic provenance of digest bytes.
notes: Use a nontrivial 32-byte pattern in addition to any all-zero fixture so byte ordering drift is visible. The newtype enforces shape but not cryptographic origin.

contract_clause: Functional Contract clauses 7 and 8; Acceptance Mapping row RecordKind Postcard bytes
domain_claim: RecordKind Postcard enum bytes and RecordKind::id() envelope IDs are distinct compatibility surfaces and must be named distinctly so a fixture for one surface cannot masquerade as the other.
model_boundary: vb_storage::records::RecordKind compatibility naming boundary between raw Postcard enum encoding and envelope_id_u16_le derived from RecordKind::id().
notes: Include RecordKind::RunAccepted and one record-family variant. Test names must contain postcard_enum or envelope_id_u16_le. Mutation should catch replacing enum fixture bytes with id bytes or vice versa.

contract_clause: Functional Contract clause 10 and Acceptance Mapping row Missing bytes return typed short decode error
domain_claim: Missing bytes on the storage decode surface produce JournalError::UnexpectedEof before payload Postcard decode is attempted.
model_boundary: Storage envelope decode boundary for persisted records, including header-length validation before payload Postcard decoding; excludes raw Postcard short-input errors outside the storage surface.
notes: Provide inputs shorter than the 60-byte header and inputs whose header declares more payload bytes than present. Raw Postcard short input is not the same error surface.

contract_clause: Functional Contract clauses 9 and 11; Acceptance Mapping row Invalid input trailing bytes return typed decode error
domain_claim: Trailing bytes are rejected by exact-value decode on the explicitly selected surface and do not silently decode to a valid value.
model_boundary: Selected raw Postcard or storage payload decode surface for malformed trailing input; the surface must be named because raw dependency errors and JournalError::PostcardDecodeFailed are different typed errors.
notes: Append at least one extra byte to an otherwise valid fixture; assert failure on raw Postcard or JournalError::PostcardDecodeFailed on a valid storage envelope constructed to reach payload decode.

contract_clause: Non-Functional Contract clauses No new runtime dependency, No Bilrost/Protobuf, No JSON wrapper; Acceptance Mapping row Postcard path contains no JSON wrapper
domain_claim: The compatibility path uses Postcard/serde only and introduces no JSON wrapper, Bilrost, Protobuf, HTTP, or runtime YAML interpretation.
model_boundary: Dependency and architecture boundary for the later compatibility tests and any touched manifests; excludes unrelated pre-existing repository dependencies outside this bead blast radius.
notes: Scan the new compatibility test and Cargo manifests touched by the bead for forbidden dependency/path tokens. This is a proof seed for later verification planning, not a command obligation.

contract_clause: Functional Contract clause 12 and Acceptance Mapping row Changing golden bytes requires named migration
domain_claim: Changing any frozen golden byte fixture is a migration event requiring an explicit named migration decision rather than silent fixture regeneration.
model_boundary: Golden fixture governance boundary for persisted/public compatibility bytes selected by this bead; excludes unrelated fixtures not tied to these RunId, WorkflowDigest, or RecordKind surfaces.
notes: A deliberate fixture byte mutation should fail a test whose name or assertion message identifies migration requirement. Do not silently regenerate fixtures in tests at assertion time.
